title: Recruiter-led bundled enrolment with cash reward (simulated)
theme: How might recruiter outreach, course bundling and cash rewards combine around the use of individual training credits?
disclaimer: SIMULATED RISK HYPOTHESIS. Produced by scripted/LLM agents role-playing incentives; it is NOT evidence that any person or organisation has behaved this way. Social media excerpts are unverified. Human approval means 'worth testing against data', not a finding of fact.

source_material.text: Cash for enrolment: Agents or recruiters offer cash for using credits and suggest attendance is optional
I signed up for a short course, then found out it's only available as part of a longer diploma. Feels misleading.
A marketing agent kept pushing my elderly mum to use her credits and mentioned a cash reward. Not sure what the course even was.
Nobody in my class ever fails. Feels like providers just pass everyone to keep the funding.

interactions.offer_text: Simulated offer: enrol in a bundled diploma using your credits; a cash reward follows once credits are applied, and attendance is presented as flexible.
interactions.response_text: Simulated: would accept, since the credits would otherwise go unused and the reward is attractive.

interactions.offer_text: Simulated: would any of your staff join the bundled diploma on the same terms?
interactions.response_text: Simulated: declines; no staff need this course and sponsorship would be traceable to the business.
